2022.rateExcludedReason: Its Carnegie basic classification in IPEDS is a special-focus medical school, medical center or research institution (C15BASIC 25, "Special Focus Four-Year: Medical Schools & Centers"; C18BASIC 25, "Special Focus Four-Year: Medical Schools & Centers"; C21BASIC 25, "Special Focus Four-Year: Medical Schools & Centers"); the rule applies in every year when any of C15BASIC, C18BASIC and C21BASIC gives such a code. Such an institution's campus holds medical or research facilities whose staff, researchers and patients are not in its FTE, so a rate per student would not measure its campus population. It has no rate; its counts are shown.
